summary: Complete list of ALL problems encountered during PROLOG variant integration. Total: 10 problems across 3 rounds. Root cause: Codex instructions lacked precise types, compilation contexts, verification steps, and exact code blocks. Each problem cost 1 debugging round.

round_1_standalone_compilation.solution: Codex provided staging tool with direct tiling load (qsfa_direct::LoadTilingWords)

round_1_standalone_compilation.problem: template_argument.h host printf in device compilation
round_1_standalone_compilation.solution: Codex provided QSFA_ASC_DIRECT_BUILD guard for host template registration

round_2_writer_integration.root_cause: Codex's prolog_ring_write_device.h used event_t but AllocEventID returns TEventID. Header was never test-compiled against CANN 9.2.1.
round_2_writer_integration.codex_should: Test-compile delivered headers against target SDK. Or document exact return types.

round_2_writer_integration.problem: VEC guard missing — Writer namespace not found in CUBE pass
round_2_writer_integration.root_cause: Writer header guarded by __DAV_C310_VEC__ only. PROLOG kernel is MIX_AIC (CUBE+VEC). Integration code referenced Writer without VEC guard in both passes.
round_2_writer_integration.solution: Added VEC guard around ALL Writer references in entry and header
round_2_writer_integration.codex_should: PROLOG_INLINE_INTEGRATION.md must state: 'ALL Writer references in the mixed kernel MUST be wrapped in #if defined(__DAV_C310_VEC__). Here is the exact guard pattern for each location.'

round_2_writer_integration.problem: Ring write call missing from initial integration
round_2_writer_integration.symptom: recent128Writer_ count=2 (declaration + setter only, no write call in RmsNormAndQuantizeCkv)
round_2_writer_integration.root_cause: Integration script's detection was fooled by 'Recent128 ring write' COMMENT string elsewhere in file. Actual write call never inserted.
round_2_writer_integration.solution: Force-added after DataSyncBarrier. Verified with count=5.
round_2_writer_integration.codex_should: Integration instructions must include verification: 'After integration, grep count of recent128Writer_ must be >= 5. If < 5, write call is missing.'

round_3_tbe_installation.symptom: LoadDataRepeatParam constructor requires 3 arguments, but 4 were provided
round_3_tbe_installation.root_cause: Source has #if ASC_DEVKIT_VERSION_NUM >= 90000000 conditional. ASC_DEVKIT_VERSION_NUM not defined in standalone, so old API branch taken. Old=4 args, new=3 args.
round_3_tbe_installation.solution: Removed conditional, used new API SetLoadDataRepeatWithStride directly
round_3_tbe_installation.codex_should: Staging tool should handle ALL version conditionals. Or document: 'ASC_DEVKIT_VERSION_NUM not defined standalone. Source has version conditionals needing manual resolution.'

round_3_tbe_installation.root_cause: Staging manifest listed symbol names but NO VALUES. Found value (=4) ourselves from bisheng header.
round_3_tbe_installation.codex_should: Manifest must provide ACTUAL VALUES: 'ASCENDC_TPL_MIX_AIC_1_1 = 4 (= KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1)'. Not just names.

round_3_tbe_installation.symptom: Build reported SUCCESS but .so timestamp unchanged (cached .o)
round_3_tbe_installation.root_cause: cmake --build used cached .o after source modification
round_3_tbe_installation.solution: rm -rf build && full clean rebuild. Verified fresh [Building] line in output.
round_3_tbe_installation.codex_should: Build instructions must include: 'After source modifications, ALWAYS clean rebuild. Verify .so timestamp is fresh and [Building] line appears.'

round_3_tbe_installation.problem: ABI marker on function vs module level
round_3_tbe_installation.root_cause: prolog_provider.py contract states 'FUNCTION must declare recent128_abi_version=1; module-level marker is insufficient'. But wrapper only had module-level marker.
round_3_tbe_installation.codex_should: When providing wrapper templates, include the function-attribute pattern: 'func.recent128_abi_version = 1' not just module-level variable.

mandatory_in_future_instructions: 1. Exact types: 'use TEventID not event_t' — never approximate
2. Compilation context guards: 'wrap in #if defined(__DAV_C310_VEC__)' with exact code
3. Verification steps: 'grep count must be N' after each integration step
4. Actual values for symbols: 'CONSTANT = 4 from specific header'
5. Known SDK incompatibilities: list all version conditionals in source
6. Clean rebuild instruction: 'rm -rf build && cmake && cmake --build'
7. Complete code blocks: provide exact code to insert, not descriptions
9. Test-compile delivered headers against actual SDK before pushing
10. Expected file locations and installation paths

final_status: All 10 problems resolved. PROLOG_V3_recent128 variant fully integrated and installed on both nodes (178 + 209). Python wrapper registered with ABI=1. TBE operator ready for dynamic compilation on first call. Service start pending user.
